subject: crtf-d
title: (R)CRTF.D.----POL.DY.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-8, second of two on book p250, paired with v2-p250-1. (R)CRTF-D (the reality of cross-transfer definitions) is crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics): the question is what cross-transfer-definitions produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with political-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real cross-transfer-definitions (the actual music made by touring musicians) is what political-dynamics had to absorb. DEC (decentralization) and POL-DY itself form the upper-center cluster; DEC rises from the main line. A vertical from the main line runs down to (R)INT (reality of intention), which carries (R)DOC (reality of documentation) to the right. From (R)DOC come PROG-SIGN (progressional significance), which carries DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) at the upper-right, with MT-INFO (multi-information) hanging from DIS-C-CT, and STF (source transfer) below. DE-SPTL (despiritualization) hangs from STF on the lower-right margin; TRS (transition) hangs from DE-SPTL at the bottom-center, and EXPM (expansionism) from TRS on the lower-left. Structural argument: cross-transfer-definitions-as-real crossed with political-dynamics branches through reality-intention as central hub. The despiritualization output is structurally telling: political-dynamics crossed with real cross-transfer-definitions produces despiritualization (the dissolution of place-bound musical identity), exposing why the touring impact functioned as transformation rather than merely as documentation.
